FlowEdit.title: FlowEdit
FlowEdit.description:
Replace the workflow's outcomes, next-step rules and repeat groups (version 2).
Steps left out have none. After Start a started step keeps its outcomes and rules,
and a repeat group with a started step keeps its steps, review step, ending outcome
and stall rule; its round limit can still be raised.

FlowStep.title: FlowStep
FlowStep.description:
One step's outcomes and next-step rules in a flow edit. `expected_work_revision`
is optional; when given, the edit is refused if the step's work changed meanwhile.

ImportAcceptance.title: ImportAcceptance
ImportAcceptance.description: Explicit human acceptance of a completed standalone task's existing result.

LoopDecision.title: LoopDecision
LoopDecision.description:
The owner's choice when a loop or an outcome waits for them. Every decision is
recorded beside the outcome that caused it.

OutcomeReport.title: OutcomeReport
OutcomeReport.description:
The step's declared result. The route it selects is applied when the work is
accepted under the step's own approval rule, never by the report itself.

RepeatGroup.title: RepeatGroup
RepeatGroup.description:
A bounded repeat-until loop: members repeat until the review step reports
`exit_outcome`, at most `max_rounds` rounds before the owner decides.

ReportedOutcome.title: ReportedOutcome
ReportedOutcome.description:
The outcome reported for a step's current work revision, shown to its reviewer.
`applied` is true once acceptance applied the route it selected.

workflow_revision.title: Workflow Revision
workflow_revision.description: Send as expected_revision when reporting an outcome.

work_revision.title: Work Revision
work_revision.description: Send as expected_work_revision when reporting an outcome.

RoundContext.title: RoundContext
RoundContext.description:
What a step's worker is told about its outcomes and loop round (version 2).
Empty outcomes and a null group on version-1 workflows.

StepOutcome.title: StepOutcome
StepOutcome.description:
A result a step may report (semantics version 2). Outcomes are optional: a step
without any behaves like a version-1 step and simply lets its dependents proceed.

StepRoute.title: StepRoute
StepRoute.description:
What happens next for one outcome. `step` is a branch to one direct dependent,
`return` starts a new round of the reporter's repeat group at an earlier member.

TaskAcceptance.title: TaskAcceptance
TaskAcceptance.description: Immutable result acceptance for this exact task/work revision.

actor_agent_id.title: Actor Agent Id
actor_agent_id.description: Owner UUID fallback when verified proxy identity is unavailable

TaskAutonomyUpdate.title: TaskAutonomyUpdate
TaskAutonomyUpdate.description: Only the project owner may change a task's future approval authority.

VisibilityCheck.title: VisibilityCheck
VisibilityCheck.description:
GH #350 (spec §4.14): fresh server eligibility for Hide / Restore. `can_hide` is true
only for a completed or cancelled workflow with no live worker turn that is not already
hidden; `can_restore` only for a hidden one. Blockers carry the exact reason.

WorkflowImpact.title: WorkflowImpact
WorkflowImpact.description: The full detail plus what the previewed Start, release or cancel would do.
